scope: Theorem 3.1 (Mixed projection moment and exact density version) of the manuscript “Replacing Gaussian observations in memory-constrained inference” (preprints/Replacing-Gaussian-observations-in-memory-constrained-inference-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 623197ae012dfb0c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n = d − 1, let m, r, q ≥ 1 be integers, and put ℓ = m + r. Suppose ℓ < n, ℓ − m − (q − 1) ≥ 1. (8) Let ρ be a finite nonnegative Borel measure on Sd−1. Suppose that B, D > 0 and, for every z ∈ Rd and t > 0, ρ(B(z, t)) ≤ Btℓ , ρ(B(z, t)) ≤ Dtn . (9) Let X ∼ γm and Z ∼ γr be independent, and set G = (X; Z). For δ > 0, define the cube average pρ,δ(g, y) = (2δ)−ℓ ∫ 1{∥gu−y∥∞≤δ} dρ(u). There is an absolute C such that, for every fixed s ∈ Sd−1 and every δ > 0, [EX (EZpρ,δ((X; Z), (X; Z)s))q ]1/q ≤ eCd B ( 1 + log+ (D/B) ) . (10) If in addition ρ ≪ σ, use the jointly Borel density pρ in (3). There is a measurable set Eρ ⊂ Sd−1, with ρ(Eρ) = 0, such that for every s / ∈ Eρ the cube averages converge to pρ(G, Gs) for γℓ-almost every G, and [EX (EZpρ((X; Z), (X; Z)s))q ]1/q ≤ eCd B ( 1 + log+ (D/B) ) . (11) When ρ ̸= 0, Eρ may also be chosen so that 0 < pρ(G, Gs) < ∞ for γℓ-almost every G and every s / ∈ Eρ.
